pages.raw_meta: Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a civil infrastructure and site development services provider operating in the Southeast that is delivering integrity from the ground up.
raw_blocks: Civil Infrastructure Services, Delivering Integrity from the Ground Up

Across the Southeast, the neighborhoods, commercial developments, roads and other infrastructure taking shape all start in the same place: the ground. Cardinal Infrastructure Group ( NASDAQ: CDNL ) is a vertically integrated civil infrastructure and site development platform serving residential, commercial, industrial and municipal projects.

Our operating companies self-perform site work from preconstruction to paving, including grading, site clearing, erosion control, underground utilities, drilling and blasting, and asphalt paving. Bringing multiple phases of the work under one accountable team gives our clients a single point of responsibility across the site.

At Cardinal, relationships come first and that shows in how we treat our clients, team members, partners and communities. Every decision is guided by doing what's right and what creates long-term value for everyone.
Site development across multiple phases, under one accountable team.
Local expertise. Shared standards. One Cardinal.
Vertically integrated. Disciplined acquirer. Founder led.

The strongest relationships we build are inside our company. At Cardinal, we hire the right people and trust them to uphold our standards. Those who take pride in their work, value taking care of clients and each other, and communicate clearly excel and build long-term careers. By investing in our people, we keep the expertise needed to deliver.
One company, with crews, equipment and expertise across the Southeast.

pages.raw_title: Civil Construction Services | Cardinal Infrastructure Group
pages.raw_meta: Cardinal Infrastructure Group delivers end to end civil construction and site development through a vertically integrated, self performing platform.
raw_blocks: We approach large-scale development differently.

Founded in 2013 and led by executives with more than 30 years in the field, we know the value of relationships. We've built our reputation on delivering for everyone who works with us. At Cardinal, we plan carefully, communicate early, and work to the agreed on schedule and specifications. Partners run their businesses to take advantage of the opportunities in front of them. Employees know they can make the right call so that work moves forward safely. We show up, communicate clearly and deliver on what we promise.

And we grow with the same intent, by doing work right the first time and acquiring companies whose people and standards match our own. That foundation guides every decision we make. It's how we deliver Integrity from the Ground Up.
93% proud to work at Cardinal

Bringing multiple phases under one team means one point of accountability for the site, and fewer gaps between phases. Our team is responsible for the scope, and you get work done to our standards and results we answer for directly.
With work sequenced in-house, we anticipate what's next and keep work moving. Having access to the crews, equipment and resources to keep your project moving helps us deliver on tight schedules.

Being a partner starts before the work does. We plan scope, schedules and budgets with you before crews mobilize. From preconstruction through closeout we stay close, communicate early and honestly, and bring solutions.

We put our people first. Safety is a commitment we make to each other and to the communities where we build, backed by ongoing training and a dedicated safety team. It's a standard we hold every day, on every site.
We're growing across the Southeast and adding crews in every market we serve. We invest in real training, modern equipment and the support individuals need to build a rewarding career with Cardinal.

We pursue acquisitions that expand our geographic footprint or build density in our existing markets. Cultural fit is one of the main the deciding factors. We integrate companies whose people share our same standards, take care of their teams and want to keep building with us.
Why We're Built This Way
Every capability we've brought in-house traces back to one idea: control the work and you control the outcome.

pages.raw_title: Cardinal Infrastructure companies | Cardinal Infrastructure Group
pages.raw_meta: Explore the Cardinal Infrastructure companies, delivering specialized expertise in heavy civil construction, infrastructure development and related site services.
raw_blocks: Full-service civil infrastructure service provider
Founded in 2013, Cardinal Civil Contracting delivers infrastructure site development services from preconstruction and mass grading through underground utilities installation across the Carolinas.
A fourth-generation site developer with deep roots in the Georgia market, A.L. Grading Contractors provides clearing, grading, erosion control and underground utility services across the state.
Fine grading, paving, curb and stone
Aviator Paving delivers full-service grading and paving solutions, using the highest-quality materials through our wholly owned asphalt plant.
Drilling, blasting and crushing services
North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia

Civil Drilling & Blasting provides rock removal, drilling, blasting and crushing services supporting building foundations, roadway construction, infrastructure installation and retaining wall projects across the Southeast.
Municipal, commercial and residential paving
Allied Paving is a heavy site and roadway construction company that specializes in crushed stone base, asphalt paving and milling for Georgia development projects.
Five companies, one set of standards. Each has deep roots in its own market and its own specialty, and together they cover multiple phases of site development.
Why We're Built This Way
